headline: Flight Centre Suffers Cyber Incident Impacting Customer Accommodation Systems
summary: Flight Centre experienced a cyber security incident affecting its accommodation booking system and travel brands including Travel Associates and Cruiseabout.
why: Cyber security breaches can disrupt operational continuity, trigger regulatory penalties, and temporarily depress consumer trust in affected travel and retail firms.

impacts.name: Flight Centre Travel Group
impacts.why: A disruptive cyber incident on core booking platforms can affect operational revenues and client confidence.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
